For a 50-person Indian company, these are three offers worth requesting quotes for now:

MakeMyTrip myBiz — ₹0 platform fee advertised; booking costs vary by itinerary. Corporate fares, GST invoices, expense management, policy controls and 24-hour assistance. 
MakeMyTrip Business
+1

Verify: airfare/hotel markup, convenience fees, cancellation/date-change charges, GST-credit eligibility, dedicated-account support.

FCM Travel India — Custom quote; no public fixed fee. Includes corporate inventory, dedicated consultant, 24/7 support and negotiated hotel rates; FCM cites potential hotel savings of up to 38%. 
FCM Travel
+1

Verify: implementation fee, per-transaction/service fees, minimum annual spend, SLA, after-hours charges and cancellation handling.

American Express Global Business Travel — Custom quote; no public India price. Enterprise travel-management and expense solutions, with tailored/high-touch service options. 
American Express

Verify: India availability for your company size, transaction fees, minimum commitment, implementation cost, SLA and emergency-support terms.

Before paying: demand a written 12-month all-in TCO covering booking fees, markups, GST, cancellations, amendments, implementation and support.
